# MWCC (mwccpsp 3.0.1 build 219, -O4,p -sdatathreshold 0) codegen notes for Hot Shots Tennis: Get a Grip

Verified findings only: each line names the function where it was proven. Matching agents read this first
and append new verified findings (one `cat >> docs/MWCC-NOTES.md` per finding, never rewriting the file).

## Source shape
- The game is C++ with MSL-style containers. Empty variadic stubs are C++ `extern "C" void f(...)` (0x8822c).
- Ghidra often inverts if/else; try both orders (0x17dab8).
- Ghidra drops parentheses on non-associative float chains: `a * b * c` may be `a * (b * c)` (0x17dab8).
- Ghidra prints a signed `x / 2^k` as `if (x < 0) x = x + (2^k-1); ... x >> k`; only `x / 2^k` gives retail's
  bgez/sra/addiu/sra (0xee44c).
- Ghidra hoists repeated subexpressions (index products) into temporaries the source wrote inline (0xee44c).
- Ghidra turns `for (...) { if (hit) { r = i; break; } } return r;` into early returns; the break form
  matches (0x2535f0).
- Struct member access compiles like char-pointer arithmetic, not integer arithmetic: an int-typed base
  with `(base + i*4 + 0x3c)` gives different operand order; `self->items[i]` (or `char *` base with
  `base + 0x3c + i*4`) matches (0x2535f0).
- A global used as a struct base must be a pointer: with an int global, offsets > 0x7fff compile to
  `addiu 0x7fff` + rest (and unaligned swl/swr); retail is lui/addu with a negative offset (0x22c15c, 0x22c4ac).
- Module addresses Ghidra prints as numbers (`(T *)0x34179c`, `FUN(0x30fe20)`) are symbol addresses in
  retail: lui/addiu %hi/%lo, never lui/ori. Use `&DAT_0034179c` (0x1b5594). For `index + 0x338b58`
  write the base first: `(int)&DAT_00338b58 + index` (0xee44c).
- Calls passing a float to a callee without a prototype promote it to double (`__extendsfdf2`); give the
  callee a prototype with `float` parameters (0x97110).

## Frame / stack
- A 16-byte stack slot appears for: an empty allocator class passed by value to a non-inline function; an
  allocator temporary used as `Alloc().allocate(n)`; an address-taken local (e.g. `size` bound to a
  `const&` in a `less<>` functor call). Empty temporaries inside inline functions are optimised away.
- Address-taken locals are laid out in declaration order from the frame top; sorting Ghidra's
  `local_N`/`uStack_N` declarations by N ascending fixes many mismatches.
- `std::max` returning `const&` puts its operands on the stack; `const int&` locals avoid constant folding.
- A by-value char-member struct reaching the callee as `f.v` produces `move v0,zero; andi v0,0xff; seb`.
- Small structs are copied with lwc1/swc1 when passed/returned by value.

## Registers / branches
- `x < y` as the FIRST operand of `||` is computed into a register (`sltu v0/v1; bnez`); written as
  `y > x` or `y <= x` it compiles to `sltu at; bnez at`. A single `if (a < b)` uses `sltu at; beqz at`;
  `if (a >= b)` goes through a register (0xd8c98). A `greater`-style functor `Greater()(n, cap)` instead of
  `Less()(cap, n)` kept the functor's frame slot and fixed the register.
- Branch-likely with a store in the delay slot comes from both paths merging into one store:
  `T *mem = new(...); if (mem) mem = ctor(mem, ...); T *o = mem;` (0x134414); ternary and if/else forms
  stay 2 words off.
- A constructor writing through a local copy of `this` (`L *self = this; self->a = 0; ...`) stops MWCC
  folding `&y.b` into one offset (0x2291cc).

## Pragmas (allowed per file)
- `#pragma opt_strength_reduction off` when retail recomputes `base + i*k` instead of walking a pointer.
- `#pragma inline_depth(8)` for deep inline chains (container code).

## Runtime symbols (in symbols/EBOOT.BIN.txt)
- operator new 0xbcc `__nw__FUi`, delete 0xa00 `__dl__FPv`, delete[] 0x9e4 `__dla__FPv`, `__getreent` 0xfe3c
  (stderr at +0xc), fprintf 0xf3e8, abort 0xd518, length_error thrower 0x43b4, memmove 0x11090
  (`FUN_00011090`), memset 0x114c0 (`FUN_000114c0`).

## Virtual dispatch only comes out as `lw t9` in C++
A C function-pointer call through a vtable slot compiles to `lw v0,slot(a0); jalr v0`; retail's
`lw t9,0(a0); lw t9,slot(t9); jalr t9` is C++ virtual dispatch. This build's vtable has TWO
header slots before the first virtual, so a call to vtable offset 0x1c is the SIXTH declared
virtual (index 5), 0x24 is index 7, 0x34 index 11, 0x58 index 20, 0x9c index 37. Declare only the
explicit parameters -- `this` is implicit, and extra explicit args show up as extra `move aN`
arguments that retail does not have.
## Reusing the variable as a ternary result keeps it in the call's return register
`*(int *)(p + 0x564) = v != 0 ? FUN_00218c00(v) : 0;` makes MWCC sink the store into the zero path
(`beqzl v0, after; sw v0,off`). Writing it as
    if (v != 0)
        v = FUN_00218c00(v);
    *(int *)(p + 0x564) = v;
gives retail's shape: `beqzl v0, store; sw v0,off; jal; move a0,v0; store` -- the result variable
is coalesced with the callee's return register, so no `move` appears. Assigning the same ternary to
a fresh local instead costs a copy (`move v1,v0`) and one extra word.
## `% 2` on a 15-bit field keeps the signed-remainder fix-up
`((seed >> 16) & 0x7fff) % 2` compiles to `ext v0,v1,16,15; bgez v0,end; andi a3,v0,1; ...;
addiu a3,a3,-2`, i.e. the sign-fixing arm is dead but still emitted. Writing `& 1` instead drops
the whole `beqz`/`addiu` pair and the function no longer matches.
## Argument setup that differs only in order
When two `addiu aN,sp,off` argument setups come out swapped, the difference is the order MWCC's
scheduler emitted them in for the same call; the call itself is exact. Nothing in the source
changes it in the handful of cases seen here (0x001ca4a8's `FUN_00022434(t, param_1 + 0xa0, v)`).

- (lane fm6, unreviewed by the main session)
When two `addiu aN,sp,off` argument setups come out swapped, the order is decided by the argument's
TYPE, not by the statement order. 0x001ca4a8's `FUN_00022434(t, param_1 + 0xa0, v)` emitted
`addiu a1,s0,160` before `addiu a0,sp,32`; retail has a0 first. Declaring the callee as
`(float *, float *, float *)` and spelling the argument `(float *)((char *)param_1 + 0xa0)` flips
the order and the function becomes EXACT (89/89). The same argument cast straight from an int
pointer (`(float *)(param_1 + 0xa0)`) does NOT flip it, and neither does an `int` middle parameter,
so the byte cast is the part that matters: MWCC evaluates a `char *`-derived address before the
stack slot it already has, an int-typed expression after it.
## Offsets above 0x7fff need the byte cast
`*(int *)(param_1 + 0x8190)` (int parameter, int offset) makes MWCC form `addiu vN,sN,32767` and
then use UNALIGNED access pairs (`lwr`/`lwl`, `swr`/`swl`) for every field, because 0x8000 does not
fit a signed 16-bit addiu. The retail form is `lui v0,0x1; addu v0,s0,v0; sw zero,-32368(v0)` --
one clean `sw` per field, base rebuilt per access. Writing the same fields as
`*(int *)((char *)param_1 + 0x8190)` (or making the parameter itself `char *`) produces exactly
that, including the per-access `lui`/`addu` (0x001ef2ec, exact; 0x001f20d8). The byte cast also
keeps two adjacent zero stores from being merged into an `swr`/`swl` pair.
## Arm layout: identical chain, arms inline vs out of line
0x001f20d8's `if (n == 2) ... else if (n == 1) ... else if (n == 0) ...` comes out as retail's
`beql a0,2` / `beql a0,1` / `beqzl a0` / `b end` chain (every arm out of line) only when the
comparison is a `switch`-like chain; our build inlines the first arm and branches around it
(`bnel a0,v0,skip`), and a real `switch (n)` emits the chain in ascending case order (0,1,2)
rather than retail's descending 2,1,0. That layout difference is the whole remaining delta of
that function (100/99 words, 62 differ); it is a scheduler choice, not a source shape.
## `hstdiff` shows the last compiled object, not the current source
`tools/hstdiff.py` only disassembles `build/<module>/<dir>__<stem>/text.bin` next to the retail
bytes; it never compiles. An edited `wip/` file therefore diffs its OLD object and the diff looks
unchanged. Always run `python tools/hstmatch.py <file>` first, then `hstdiff` for the instruction
detail. A file with no `text.bin` at all (a fresh name) diffs as an empty left column, which reads
like a total mismatch rather than "not compiled yet".

## 2026-10-23 - 0x000ba78c: delete loops need each guard twice, and an `else` between them costs 2 words
A `for` loop releasing two slot arrays (`p = <field>; if (p != 0) delete p;`) only reaches retail's word count
when the null test is written twice: `if (p != 0) { if (p != 0) { delete p; slot = 0; } }`. Retail's slot block
holds three tests (outer guard, redundant guard, delete's own inline test) and MWCC folds a lone guard away
(116 words vs 120, 81 words differing). Writing the second field's load once after the first block instead of
inside an `if/else` pair is what shares the reload: with an `else` MWCC sinks a private `lw` into the first
branch's delay slot (2 words differ at the redundant-guard branch); without it, the reload is a single join
site and the redundant guard becomes `beqz` + `nop` targeting it. The redundant guard is harmless here since
its body is null-tested again.

the HIGHEST-address body. Retail here compares 0x18,0x12,0xc,0xb,0xa,0xe,0x14,8,0 and puts case 0's body at the
lowest address, so the source must list `case 0`, `case 8`, `case 0x14`, `case 0xe`, ... `case 0x18` - writing

## Address-split trap (2026-10-24)
A `lui 0x35` paired with a negative low half such as `-22828` addresses **0x34A6D4**, not 0x35A6D4, under mwcc's `(addr + 0x8000) >> 16` split. Reading the `lui` immediate as the base is wrong; retyping symbols on that reading cost 0x0023fad8 five differing words (196 -> 201) before it was reverted. Derive the base from `(hi << 16) + (int16)lo` instead.
## FPR round-trip lever (2026-10-24)
Holding integer values (keys, pointers, counts) as `float` locals taken from the bit pattern (`float f = *(float *)&x;`) and re-reading them as ints (`*(int *)&f`) forces mwcc to emit `sw`/`lwc1`/`swc1`/`lw` spill traffic instead of plain register moves. On 0x001c70c0 this added 13 words exactly where retail has them: 21 -> 34 of retail's 38.
## Disassembly vs source address space (2026-10-24)
`hstdis.py` prints **ram-address-space** addresses; source headers carry the file-space `data=` address. A constant shown at `0x2e8b38` lives at `0x002d8b38` — the offset is 0x10000 on this module. Reading the disassembly address as a source address yields nonsense bytes (at 0x2e8b38 you get `f4592e00 7a010000 01010101`; the real 12-byte PTMF at 0x2d8b38 is `{0, -1, 0x00102660}`).
## Declaration order sets frame slots (2026-10-24)
mwcc assigns stack slots in **local declaration order**, so a residue that shows a uniform +4/-4 offset across every `sp`-relative access is a declaration-order fault, not an opcode fault. On 0x002918f0 `char *local;` declared before `V tmp` put the spill at 28(sp) and the float triple at 16/20/24, while retail had the spill at 16 and the triple at 20/24/28; moving `V tmp = *(V *)v;` first shifted every access by +4 and closed all 8 differing words (57/57 -> EXACT, installed).
## When the FPR staging lever maps (2026-10-24)
Applies **only** when retail's `sw X,N(sp)` / `lwc1 $f,N(sp)` chains stage a **scalar the source controls** — a search key (0x001c70c0, 0x00103f74), an iterator pointer (0x00103f74), or a scalar carried into a call.
Does **not** map, and must be skipped without a compile, when the chains are:
1. **genuine float arithmetic against rodata** — lwc1 from a global base plus swc1 of the same register (0x00102490, where the 0x002d8b38 bytes are a 12-byte PTMF, not floats);
2. **`sw zero` vector/struct initialisation** — mwcc zeroes float aggregates with integer stores (pos_get_0027db5c, 16/20/24);
3. **a struct argument temp** — e.g. a 16-byte `Vec4` colour for an inlined `SetColor(Vec4)` (node_pair_create_000e59e4, 64-88);
4. **a struct-return copy** — a 12-byte `It` temporary copied field-by-field into its destination (container_find_index_0014c274, 48-56; six earlier shapes already disproved there).
Dose matters as much as mapping: on iterator code the **single-pointer** dose worked (0x00103f74 98 -> 105/105) while the full pair overshot (0x001c67e8 29 -> 43/44). Keep rule: **words improved OR differ improved OR EXACT**.

## CSE: address-level vs value-level (2026-10-24)
The cast trick (`*(int *)((char *)p + 0x50)`) defeats a CSE on a shared **address expression** — it converted 0x0008add8. It does **not** defeat a CSE on a loaded **value**: on 0x002a45d8 retail recomputes `lbu / addiu -4 / sltiu 2` for the same `(byte@+0x324 - 4) < 2` guard twice, and neither `(char *)DAT_003415a8 + 0x324` nor a `volatile unsigned char *` read made mwcc re-emit the trio — both measured identically at 214/216, 115 differ. Distinguish the two before spending a probe: if the shared thing is an address, re-spell it; if it is a loaded byte or a comparison on one, the source has no handle on the CSE.
## Frame-slot delta: cause vs consequence (2026-10-24)
A uniform sp-relative delta is only *actionable* when it is the **cause**: same frame size on both sides, the same number of distinct slots, and every paired access shifted by the same constant — i.e. one block of values sitting at different addresses. Check those three numbers before spending a compile (`try/lane-work/frameclass.py`). 0x002918f0 was this case and reordering declarations fixed it. When the delta is a **consequence** — frame size differs, or one side uses more distinct slots because it spilled a value the other kept in a register — no declaration permutation can move it; the 0x002a8fbc, state_dispatch pair and clamp_vec_reset trials all failed for that reason. Inventory result: of 10 remaining uniform-delta files, all 10 classify as cause by frame size and slot count, 4 have no declaration block to permute (0-1 locals at function scope), and the 6 with a real block (ctor_court_intro, ctor_regulation, ctor_main_result, game_slot_select, release_handles, vec_reserve_copy) took 5 permutations each — 30 compiles, **zero drops**. So the cause/consequence test is necessary but not sufficient: a genuine cause still only converts when the shifted block is the one whose order mwcc is choosing differently.
- Differ counts are not size-normalised: a variant that emits two fewer words can shed one "differing" word for free, because the comparison runs over a shorter stream. For any edit that changes instruction count, require the differ drop to exceed the size delta before calling it an alignment gain, or judge by the first-diff offset instead — 0x00267f24's entity retype moved differ 321 → 320 while dropping two words, i.e. indistinguishable from noise.
- **Keep/restore rule, final form.** A variant is an alignment gain only if the differing-word drop *exceeds* the size delta it introduced, measured in the direction of retail: for a file **under** retail the word count must rise (shortfall shrink) and for a file **over** retail it must fall, with the differ count judged net of that movement. Raw differ drops on size-changing edits are not evidence — a shorter stream has fewer words available to differ, so shedding one differing word per two words removed is arithmetic, not alignment. The sounder signal is the **first-diff offset**: a real alignment gain moves the first divergence later even when the counts move little.
- **By-value aggregate lever (established on 0x00203680).** A stack home is a consequence of where the ABI puts a value, never something the source can request. Routing an aggregate through `static inline T holdX(T v) { return v; }` and using `T q = holdX(*p);` makes the compiler give the copy a callee-owned home, producing the `lwc1`/`swc1` staging retail has: on quad_project this moved **70 → 83/155 words, differ 153 → 145** with the first diff moving from +0x0 to +0x4. The failed alternatives, all disproved on the same file, are instructive: `volatile T *q = &local` (folded, lost a word), scalar `$f20` liveness probes (re-materialised), and an argument-list shuffle (neutral). **Second application, six outputs:** wrapping `struct Proj { float a..f; }` through `holdProj` after the call that fills it by address moved **83 → 107/155**, differ 145 → 147 — a 24-word gain with a 2-word differ rise and the first diff moving back to +0x0. The lever bites for aggregates that *arrive* by value; for ones already given up by address it re-introduces a copy rather than recovering retail's placement, so use it for entry copies and returns, not for call outputs.
- **Output-array lever (measured once, does not transfer).** Spelling a group of address-taken outputs as `float out[N]` and passing `&out[0]`…`&out[N-1]` beat six separate scalars on **both** metrics on 0x00203680: 83/155 words differ 145 → **82/155 differ 143**, first diff unchanged at +0x4. Do not re-run this sweep without new input: the idiom is essentially unique to quad_project in this tree.
- **Symmetric-vs-steep test for register residues (use before any permutation).** From a file's paired listing, extract the register appearing on each side of every differing row and build the map ours→retail. If the map is a bijection whose counts match (`co[a] == cr[b]` for every pair), the exchange is a **symmetric pair** — two equally good candidates that the allocator picked differently — and no declaration permutation can steer it; do not spend compiles. If one register carries a clearly longer live range (count spread >= 2) the assignment is **steeply ranked** and ordering *may* steer it. Use this test to skip symmetric files outright, not to promise that steep ones will convert.
